Flowingly is a leader in AI-powered workflow automation and process
improvement software. We're expanding rapidly and looking for Full Stack
Developers to help us build the future of intuitive, intelligent business solutions.
If you’re passionate about developing cutting-edge AI-driven features and
thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, we want to hear from you.
About Flowingly
At Flowingly, we empower organizations around the world to streamline
operations through no-code process mapping, automation, and now,
embedded AI solutions. Our mission is simple: make powerful workflow
automation accessible to every business user – not just IT.
We foster innovation, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re passionate about
shaping the future of work through intuitive technology.
The Role
As a Full Stack Developer, you will:
Build & Innovate: Develop scalable front-end and back-end solutions that
power our AI and automation features.
Shape the Future: Help drive the evolution of Flowingly’s AI capabilities,
from smarter workflows to predictive insights.
Code Excellence: Write, review, and maintain high-quality, standardsdriven code to ensure performance, security, and reliability.
Problem Solve: Approach complex challenges with creativity and a
solution-focused mindset.
What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who is:
Experienced: 5+ years of experience in software development, with
expertise in GIT, SQL, C#, .NET Web API, HTML/CSS, JavaScript (JS),
TypeScript (TS), and strong React/TS proficiency.
AI-Curious: Previous experience integrating AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure
OpenAI) or a strong interest in AI innovation is highly valued.

JD example

5


Skilled: Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, and
modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure).
Collaborative: Excellent communication skills to work across teams, time
zones, and cultures.
Organised: Able to juggle priorities and deliver projects on time.
Innovative: Eager to keep learning and stay ahead of emerging tech trends,
especially in AI and automation.
Why Join Flowingly?
Shape the Future: Play a key role in embedding AI into real-world business
processes.
Global Reach: Work on a platform used by organizations across Australia,
New Zealand, and beyond.
Career Growth: Opportunity to grow with a fast-scaling SaaS company.
Flexible Work: Hybrid or remote working options to suit your lifestyle.
Dynamic Culture: A collaborative, open-minded team where your voice and
ideas matter.
Competitive Package: Attractive salary, bonuses, and benefits for the right
candidate.

Employer questions

Your application will include the following questions:
Have you worked in a role which requires JavaScript development
experience?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in New
Zealand?
How many years' experience do you have as a full stack developer?
Which of the following programming languages are you experienced in?
Have you worked in a role which requires C# development experience?
How many years' experience do you have in a software development role?
